name: Titanium.UI.iOS
summary:
Apple iOS specific UI capabilities.  All properties, methods and events in this namespace will
only work on Apple iOS devices.

properties.name: CACHE_POLICY_RELOAD_IGNORING_LOCAL_CACHE_DATA
properties.summary:
Specifies that the data for the URL load should be loaded from the originating source.
No existing cache data should be used to satisfy a URL load request.
properties.description: Use with [Titanium.UI.WebView.cachePolicy](api:Titanium.UI.WebView#cachePolicy).

properties.name: CACHE_POLICY_RETURN_CACHE_DATA_DONT_LOAD
properties.summary:
Specifies that the existing cache data should be used to satisfy a request,
regardless of its age or expiration date.
properties.description:
Use with [Titanium.UI.WebView.cachePolicy](api:Titanium.UI.WebView#cachePolicy). If there is no existing data in the cache corresponding
to a URL load request, no attempt is made to load the data from the originating source, and the load
is considered to have failed. This constant specifies a behavior that is similar to an offline mode.

properties.name: CACHE_POLICY_RETURN_CACHE_DATA_ELSE_LOAD
properties.summary:
Specifies that the existing cached data should be used to satisfy the request,
regardless of its age or expiration date.
properties.description:
Use with [Titanium.UI.WebView.cachePolicy](api:Titanium.UI.WebView#cachePolicy). If there is no existing data in the cache
corresponding the request, the data is loaded from the originating source.

properties.name: CACHE_POLICY_USE_PROTOCOL_CACHE_POLICY
properties.summary:
Specifies that the caching logic defined in the protocol implementation, if any,
is used for a particular URL load request.
properties.description:
Use with [Titanium.UI.WebView.cachePolicy](api:Titanium.UI.WebView#cachePolicy). This is the default policy for URL load requests.
If you are making HTTP or HTTPS byte-range requests, always use the
[Titanium.UI.iOS.CACHE_POLICY_RELOAD_IGNORING_LOCAL_CACHE_DATA](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#CACHE_POLICY_RELOAD_IGNORING_LOCAL_CACHE_DATA) policy.

properties.name: forceTouchSupported
properties.summary: Determines if the 3D-Touch capability "Force Touch" is supported (`true`) or not (`false`) by the device.
properties.description: Returns `true` if the device supports 3D-Touch (iPhone 6S / iPhone 6S Plus and later) or `false` if not.

properties.name: GLASS_EFFECT_STYLE_CLEAR
properties.summary: Use with [BlurView.glassEffect](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.BlurView#glassEffect) to specify a clear glass effect style.
properties.description:
Creates a glass effect with higher translucency and lighter blur intensity compared to the regular style.
This style provides a more transparent appearance while still maintaining the glass effect characteristics.

properties.name: GLASS_EFFECT_STYLE_REGULAR
properties.summary: Use with [BlurView.glassEffect](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.BlurView#glassEffect) to specify a regular glass effect style.
properties.description:
Creates a standard glass effect with regular translucency and blur intensity. This is the default
style for glass effects and provides a balanced appearance suitable for most use cases.

properties.name: INJECTION_TIME_DOCUMENT_END
properties.summary: Inject the script after the document finishes loading, but before other subresources finish loading.
properties.description: Used to set the `injectionTime` argument of [Titanium.UI.WebView.addUserScript](api:Titanium.UI.WebView#addUserScript).

properties.name: INJECTION_TIME_DOCUMENT_START
properties.summary: Inject the script after the document element is created, but before any other content is loaded.
properties.description: Used to set the `injectionTime` argument of [Titanium.UI.WebView.addUserScript](api:Titanium.UI.WebView#addUserScript).

properties.name: KEYBOARD_DISMISS_MODE_INTERACTIVE
properties.summary: Use with [Titanium.UI.ScrollView.keyboardDismissMode](api:Titanium.UI.ScrollView#keyboardDismissMode) to control keyboard dismiss mode.
properties.description:
The keyboard follows the dragging touch offscreen, and can be pulled
upward again to cancel the dismiss.

properties.name: KEYBOARD_DISMISS_MODE_NONE
properties.summary: Use with [Titanium.UI.ScrollView.keyboardDismissMode](api:Titanium.UI.ScrollView#keyboardDismissMode) to control keyboard dismiss mode.
properties.description: The keyboard does not get dismissed with a drag.

properties.name: KEYBOARD_DISMISS_MODE_ON_DRAG
properties.summary: Use with [Titanium.UI.ScrollView.keyboardDismissMode](api:Titanium.UI.ScrollView#keyboardDismissMode) to control keyboard dismiss mode.
properties.description: The keyboard is dismissed when a drag begins.

properties.name: LARGE_TITLE_DISPLAY_MODE_ALWAYS
properties.summary: Always use a larger title when this item is top most.
properties.description: Use with [Titanium.UI.Window.largeTitleDisplayMode](api:Titanium.UI.Window#largeTitleDisplayMode).

properties.name: LARGE_TITLE_DISPLAY_MODE_AUTOMATIC
properties.summary:
Automatically use the large out-of-line title based on the state of the p
revious item in the navigation bar.
properties.description:
Use with [Titanium.UI.Window.largeTitleDisplayMode](api:Titanium.UI.Window#largeTitleDisplayMode). An item with this
constant will show or hide the large title based on the request of the
previous navigation item. If the first item pushed is set to Automatic,
then it will show the large title if the navigation bar has the property
[Titanium.UI.Window.largeTitleEnabled](api:Titanium.UI.Window#largeTitleEnabled) set to `true`.

properties.name: LARGE_TITLE_DISPLAY_MODE_NEVER
properties.summary: Never use a larger title when this item is top most.
properties.description: Use with [Titanium.UI.Window.largeTitleDisplayMode](api:Titanium.UI.Window#largeTitleDisplayMode).

properties.name: LIVEPHOTO_BADGE_OPTIONS_LIVE_OFF
properties.summary:
To indicate that the Live Photo aspect is turned off and it will
be treated as a still (e.g. for sharing).
properties.description:
Use with [Titanium.UI.iOS.createLivePhotoBadge](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#createLivePhotoBadge) to specify

properties.name: LIVEPHOTO_BADGE_OPTIONS_OVER_CONTENT

Use with [Titanium.UI.iOS.createLivePhotoBadge](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#createLivePhotoBadge) to specify

properties.name: LIVEPHOTO_PLAYBACK_STYLE_FULL
properties.summary:
Plays back the entire motion and sound content of the Live Photo, including transition

properties.description: This style matches the effect seen when pressing on a photo in the Photos app.

properties.name: LIVEPHOTO_PLAYBACK_STYLE_HINT
properties.summary: Plays back only a brief section of the motion content of the Live Photo, without sound.
properties.description:

properties.name: MENU_POPUP_ARROW_DIRECTION_RIGHT

properties.name: MENU_POPUP_ARROW_DIRECTION_UP

properties.name: MODAL_PRESENTATION_CURRENT_CONTEXT
properties.summary: View presented with the same style as its parent window.
properties.description:
Used with the [Titanium.UI.Window.open](api:Titanium.UI.Window#open) and [Titanium.UI.Window.close](api:Titanium.UI.Window#close) methods.

One of the group of modal window presentation style constants
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_FULL_SCREEN](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_FULL_SCREEN),
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_CONTEXT](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_CONTEXT),
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_CURRENT_CONTEXT](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_CURRENT_CONTEXT),
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_FORMSHEET](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_FORMSHEET),
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_FULLSCREEN](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_FULLSCREEN),
and [MODAL_PRESENTATION_PAGESHEET](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_PAGESHEET).

properties.name: MODAL_PRESENTATION_FORMSHEET
properties.summary:
Window width and height are smaller than those of the screen and the view is centered on
the screen.
properties.description:
If the system is in a landscape orientation and the keyboard is visible, the position of the
view is adjusted upward so that the view remains visible. All uncovered areas are dimmed
and do not respond to touch to prevent the user from interacting with them.

Used with the [Titanium.UI.Window.open](api:Titanium.UI.Window#open) and [Titanium.UI.Window.close](api:Titanium.UI.Window#close) methods.

One of the group of modal window presentation style constants
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_FULL_SCREEN](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_FULL_SCREEN),
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_CONTEXT](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_CONTEXT),
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_CURRENT_CONTEXT](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_CURRENT_CONTEXT),
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_FORMSHEET](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_FORMSHEET),
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_FULLSCREEN](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_FULLSCREEN),
and [MODAL_PRESENTATION_PAGESHEET](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_PAGESHEET).

properties.name: MODAL_PRESENTATION_FULLSCREEN
properties.summary: Window covers the screen.
properties.description:
Used with the [Titanium.UI.Window.open](api:Titanium.UI.Window#open) and [Titanium.UI.Window.close](api:Titanium.UI.Window#close) methods.

One of the group of modal window presentation style constants
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_FULL_SCREEN](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_FULL_SCREEN),
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_CONTEXT](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_CONTEXT),
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_CURRENT_CONTEXT](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_CURRENT_CONTEXT),
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_FORMSHEET](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_FORMSHEET),
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_FULLSCREEN](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_FULLSCREEN),
and [MODAL_PRESENTATION_PAGESHEET](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_PAGESHEET).

properties.name: MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_CONTEXT
properties.summary: View presented over its parent window.
properties.description:
Used with the [Titanium.UI.Window.open](api:Titanium.UI.Window#open) and [Titanium.UI.Window.close](api:Titanium.UI.Window#close) methods.

One of the group of modal window presentation style constants
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_FULL_SCREEN](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_FULL_SCREEN),
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_CONTEXT](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_CONTEXT),
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_CURRENT_CONTEXT](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_CURRENT_CONTEXT),
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_FORMSHEET](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_FORMSHEET),
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_FULLSCREEN](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_FULLSCREEN),
and [MODAL_PRESENTATION_PAGESHEET](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_PAGESHEET).

properties.name: MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_FULL_SCREEN
properties.summary: Presented view covers the screen.
properties.description:
The views beneath the presented content are not removed from the view hierarchy when the presentation finishes. So if the presented view controller does not fill the screen with opaque content, the underlying content shows through.

Used with the [Titanium.UI.Window.open](api:Titanium.UI.Window#open) and [Titanium.UI.Window.close](api:Titanium.UI.Window#close) methods.

One of the group of modal window presentation style constants
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_FULL_SCREEN](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_FULL_SCREEN),

properties.name: MODAL_PRESENTATION_PAGESHEET
properties.summary:
Window height is the height of the screen and width is equal to screen width in a portrait
orientation.
properties.description:
Any uncovered areas are dimmed and do not respond to touch, to prevent the user from
interacting with them. In portrait orientations, this option is essentially the same as
[Titanium.UI.iOS.MODAL_PRESENTATION_FULLSCREEN](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_FULLSCREEN).

Used with the [Titanium.UI.Window.open](api:Titanium.UI.Window#open) and [Titanium.UI.Window.close](api:Titanium.UI.Window#close) methods.

One of the group of modal window presentation style constants
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_FULL_SCREEN](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_FULL_SCREEN),
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_CONTEXT](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_OVER_CURRENT_CONTEXT),
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_CURRENT_CONTEXT](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_CURRENT_CONTEXT),
[MODAL_PRESENTATION_FORMSHEET](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_FORMSHEET),

and [MODAL_PRESENTATION_PAGESHEET](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_PAGESHEET).

properties.name: MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_COVER_VERTICAL
properties.summary:
When the window is presented, its view slides up from the bottom of the screen. On dismissal,
the view slides back down (default.)
properties.description:
Used with the [Titanium.UI.Window.open](api:Titanium.UI.Window#open) and [Titanium.UI.Window.close](api:Titanium.UI.Window#close) methods.

One of the group of modal window transition style constants
[MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_COVER_VERTICAL](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_COVER_VERTICAL),
[MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_CROSS_DISSOLVE](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_CROSS_DISSOLVE),
[MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_FLIP_HORIZONTAL](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_FLIP_HORIZONTAL),
and [MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_PARTIAL_CURL](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_PARTIAL_CURL).

properties.name: MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_CROSS_DISSOLVE
properties.summary:
When the window is presented, the current view fades out while the new view fades in at the
same time. On dismissal, a similar type of cross-fade is used to return to the original view.
properties.description:
Used with the [Titanium.UI.Window.open](api:Titanium.UI.Window#open) and [Titanium.UI.Window.close](api:Titanium.UI.Window#close) methods.

One of the group of modal window transition style constants
[MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_COVER_VERTICAL](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_COVER_VERTICAL),
[MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_CROSS_DISSOLVE](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_CROSS_DISSOLVE),
[MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_FLIP_HORIZONTAL](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_FLIP_HORIZONTAL),
and [MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_PARTIAL_CURL](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_PARTIAL_CURL).

properties.name: MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_FLIP_HORIZONTAL
properties.summary:
When the window is presented, the current view initiates a horizontal 3D flip from
right-to-left, resulting in the revealing of the new view as if it were on the back of the
previous view. On dismissal, the flip occurs from left-to-right, returning to the original
view.
properties.description:
Used with the [Titanium.UI.Window.open](api:Titanium.UI.Window#open) and [Titanium.UI.Window.close](api:Titanium.UI.Window#close) methods.

One of the group of modal window transition style constants
[MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_COVER_VERTICAL](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_COVER_VERTICAL),

and [MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_PARTIAL_CURL](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_PARTIAL_CURL).

properties.name: MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_PARTIAL_CURL
properties.summary:
When the window is presented, one corner of the current view curls up to reveal the modal
view underneath. On dismissal, the curled up page unfurls itself back on top of the modal
view.
properties.description:
A modal view presented using this transition is itself prevented from presenting any
additional modal views. This transition style is supported only if the window is presenting
a [Titanium.UI.iOS.MODAL_PRESENTATION_FULLSCREEN](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_PRESENTATION_FULLSCREEN) modal presentation style.

Used with the [Titanium.UI.Window.open](api:Titanium.UI.Window#open) and [Titanium.UI.Window.close](api:Titanium.UI.Window#close) methods.

[MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_COVER_VERTICAL](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_COVER_VERTICAL),
[MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_CROSS_DISSOLVE](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_CROSS_DISSOLVE),
[MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_FLIP_HORIZONTAL](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#MODAL_TRANSITION_STYLE_FLIP_HORIZONTAL),
